name: 60442 · Manhattan, IL
findings: ZIP 60442 (Manhattan) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60442 (Manhattan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
